brief_rationale: All seven responsibility-chain items are fully met with clear evidence. The doctor obtained specific blood pressure values, screened for red-flag symptoms, provided layered action plans, verified medication reconciliation through the clinic visit, confirmed ophthalmic post-op care, addressed transport barriers with near-site alternatives, and confirmed family understanding. Three high-order points are completed: safe bounded closure (HO4), responsibility chain repair via offline clinic integration (HO2), and real-world constraint navigation (HO1). No in-chain errors or important non-chain defects exist. Grade 5 requires ≥2 completed high-order points, which is satisfied.
